subject: physics
question: Bhai mechanics me pseudo force kab lagana hota hai aur iska direction kaise decide karte hain?
known_traps: Applying pseudo force from ground / inertial frame
Applying pseudo force in the same direction as frame acceleration

min_required_concepts: pseudo force tab lagate hain jab observer non-inertial (accelerating) frame me ho
magnitude F_p = m \cdot a_{frame}
direction frame ke acceleration ke theek opposite hoti hai
ground frame (inertial) me pseudo force kabhi nahi lagta
forbidden_misconceptions: pseudo force ground frame se lagaya ja sakta hai
pseudo force real contact force hai jiska Newton's third law reaction pair hota hai

subject: physics
question: Jab temperature badhta hai toh liquid aur gas dono ki viscosity me opposite behavior kyu hota hai?
known_traps: Assuming temperature increase decreases viscosity for both liquids and gases
Ignoring molecular collision frequency in gases

min_required_concepts: liquids me viscosity cohesive intermolecular forces ki wajah se hoti hai, temp badhne par bonds break hote hain toh viscosity decrease hoti hai
gases me viscosity molecules ke random thermal motion aur momentum exchange se aati hai
temp badhne par gas molecules ki speed aur momentum transfer badhta hai isliye gas viscosity increase hoti hai
forbidden_misconceptions: gas viscosity temperature badhne se ghat-ti hai
liquid aur gas dono ka viscosity mechanism same hai

subject: chemistry
question: SN1 reaction me carbocation rearrangement kab kab possible hota hai? Hydride shift aur methyl shift ka intuition batao.
known_traps: Shifting from a more stable carbocation to a less stable one

min_required_concepts: rearrangement tab hota hai jab less stable carbocation more stable (e.g. 1 degree to 2/3 degree ya resonance stabilized) me convert ho sake
1,2-hydride shift me H(-) apne electron pair ke saath adjacent positive carbon par jata hai
1,2-methyl/alkyl shift tab hota hai jab hydride shift se better stability na mile (e.g. neopentyl carbocation)
rearrangement hamesha carbocation stability badhane ke liye hota hai
forbidden_misconceptions: SN2 reaction me carbocation rearrangement hota hai
3 degree carbocation 1 degree carbocation me rearrange karega

subject: mathematics
question: Conic sections me tangent and normal ki equations (T=0 form vs slope form) ko samajhne ka systematic approach kya hai?
key_concepts: Slope Form y = mx + c with Condition of Tangency
known_traps: Using T=0 when point (x_1, y_1) lies outside the conic (gives chord of contact, not tangent)
Forgetting tangency condition c = a/m for parabola vs c = +/- sqrt(a^2m^2+b^2) for ellipse

min_required_concepts: T=0 rule point form ke liye lagta hai jab point curve par ho (x^2 -> xx_1, y^2 -> yy_1, 2x -> x+x_1)
agar point curve ke bahar hai toh T=0 chord of contact deta hai
slope form me curve aur line y=mx+c ka discriminant D=0 karke condition of tangency nikalte hain
normal ki equation tangent ke perpendicular slope (-1/m) se banti hai
forbidden_misconceptions: T=0 hamesha tangent deta hai chahe point curve par ho ya bahar
normal ka slope tangent ke slope ke barabar hota hai

subject: physics
question: Friction hamesha motion ko oppose karta hai ya relative motion ko? Real-life example se samjhao jaise walk karna ya car accelerate hona.
key_concepts: Relative Motion Opposition vs Absolute Motion Assistance
known_traps: Believing friction can never increase kinetic energy or assist motion
Assuming friction always acts backwards on all moving objects

min_required_concepts: friction absolute motion ko oppose nahi karta, balki do surfaces ke beech ki relative motion (ya tendency of slipping) ko oppose karta hai
jab hum chalte hain toh pair ground ko peeche push karta hai, reaction me static friction hume aage push karta hai (friction drives motion)
car ke driving wheels par static friction forward direction me act karta hai jisse car accelerate hoti hai
forbidden_misconceptions: friction hamesha object ko rokne ki koshish karta hai aur kabhi speed nahi badha sakta
walking me air drag chalata hai friction nahi

subject: physics
question: If a particle is moving in uniform circular motion, why is the work done by centripetal force zero? Hindi me crisp derivation ke saath explain karo.
key_concepts: Centripetal Force F_c perpendicular to Velocity v
Dot Product W = int F . dr = 0
known_traps: Claiming work done is non-zero in non-uniform circular motion (centripetal still does zero work, tangential does work)

min_required_concepts: uniform circular motion me centripetal force hamesha center ki taraf (radially inward) hota hai
velocity vector displacement dr hamesha tangent ke along hota hai
F aur dr ke beech ka angle \theta = 90^\circ hota hai
dW = \vec{F} \cdot d\vec{r} = F ds \cos(90^\circ) = 0
kinetic energy constant rehti hai toh work-energy theorem se total work done zero
forbidden_misconceptions: centripetal force tangential acceleration produce karta hai
work done is zero because particle has zero acceleration

subject: chemistry
question: How to determine the order of reaction using the initial rate method? Practical shortcut aur intuition explain karo.
known_traps: Determining order directly from stoichiometric coefficients of balanced overall equation
Changing multiple reactant concentrations simultaneously without isolating one

min_required_concepts: rate law: Rate = k[A]^x[B]^y
order theoretical balanced equation se nahi nikalta, experimental data se nikalta hai
shortcut: ek reactant [B] ko constant rakho aur [A] ko n-times karo, agar rate m-times ho jaye toh n^x = m se x nikal lo
overall order = x + y
forbidden_misconceptions: reaction order hamesha stoichiometric coefficient ke barabar hota hai
order fraction ya zero nahi ho sakta

subject: chemistry
question: Explain the difference between path functions and state functions in thermodynamics with simple enthalpy and work done examples.
key_concepts: State Function (Internal Energy U, Enthalpy H, Entropy S)
First Law of Thermodynamics Delta U = q + w
Cyclic Integral of State Function is Zero
known_traps: Treating heat q or work w as state functions
Claiming Delta H depends on the path taken between two equilibrium states

min_required_concepts: state function sirf initial aur final state par depend karta hai, path par nahi (e.g. Enthalpy H, Internal Energy U, Gibbs Free Energy G)
path function is baat par depend karta hai ki process kis path se carry out hua (e.g. Work w aur Heat q)
cyclic process me state function ka net change \oint dX = 0 hota hai jabki work done non-zero ho sakta hai
first law: \Delta U = q + w me U state function hai jabki q aur w path functions hain
forbidden_misconceptions: heat content is stored as heat in a system at equilibrium
